supports: Smyrna Dunes Park is a 184-acre inlet park along the southern shoreline of Ponce de Leon Inlet.
The park has over 2 miles of wide, elevated, handicapped-accessible boardwalk.
Multiple scenic overlooks allow views of the Atlantic Ocean, the Indian River and Ponce de Leon Inlet.
Park features include a 300-foot handicapped accessible fishing pier and dog-friendly swimming beach areas.
Admission is $10 per vehicle.
The park is at 2995 N. Peninsula Ave., New Smyrna Beach.
